title: Extend chatbot/providers/router.py with task-class-aware routing
description:
Extend the existing provider policy router in chatbot/providers/router.py with task-class awareness: casual, emotional, summarize, extract, and embed task classes mapped to different model tiers. The extension must default to a single safe model unless the operator enables automatic routing.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- chatbot/providers/router.py (existing provider router — understand current routing logic, policy model, provider registry, and model selection function signatures)
- chatbot/providers/ (package init and any existing provider adapters for identifier conventions)
- backends/openrouter_models.py (validated model identifiers)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/providers/router.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/providers/router.py and understand the existing routing logic. Identify the current function(s) that map a request to a provider/model pair. Do not rename or remove any existing functions.

2. Define a TaskClass enum or literal type with values: CASUAL, EMOTIONAL, SUMMARIZE, EXTRACT, EMBED.

3. Define a `TaskClassRoutingConfig` dataclass with:
   - `enabled`: bool (default False) — must default to False so single-model mode is the safe default.
   - `class_map`: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] — maps task class value to (provider_id, model_id) tuple. Default entries for each task class:
     * 'casual' -> ('openrouter', 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro') — cheap model
     * 'emotional' -> ('openrouter', 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro') — stronger model
     * 'summarize' -> ('openrouter', 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro') — cheap model
     * 'extract' -> ('openrouter', 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro') — stronger model
     * 'embed' -> ('openrouter', 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro') — embedding model
   - Use the real model identifiers from backends/openrouter_models.py. All default to the same model for safety; the operator can override each class independently.
   - `default_provider_id` and `default_model_id`: fallback when routing is disabled or task class is unknown.

4. Add a `select_model_for_task(task_class: str, routing_config: TaskClassRoutingConfig | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]` function that:
   - If routing_config is None, returns the existing default model/provider (unchanged behavior).
   - If routing_config.enabled is False, returns (routing_config.default_provider_id, routing_config.default_model_id).
   - If task_class is unknown or not in class_map, returns the defaults.
   - Otherwise, returns the mapped (provider_id, model_id) from class_map.
   - Validates that the returned provider/model pair is in the known registry. If not found, falls back to defaults and emits an error log.

5. Export the new types and functions. Do NOT change existing function signatures — the extension must be purely additive. Any new model identifiers routed must pass through validate_identifier() exactly like existing LLM provider IDs.

select_model_for_task returns default model when routing is disabled
select_model_for_task returns mapped model when routing is enabled and task_class known
select_model_for_task falls back to default when task_class is unknown
All model identifiers are validated before being returned
Existing routing functions and signatures are unchanged

change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

add a function that maps task class to provider/model
default all classes to the same safe model
validate returned model identifiers against the provider registry
